name: Sorting Algorithms
description: A complexity comparison of common sorting algorithms, plus implementations of insertion sort, quicksort (annotated with the cost of each line), counting sort, and radix sort built on it.
highlights: Best, average and worst-case bounds side by side, and the Ω(n log n) limit for comparison sorts
Quicksort with a per-line cost breakdown of partitioning
Radix sort as repeated stable counting sorts, one decimal digit at a time
